# WS-10G1 miniPaint controlled-extraction notice

WS-10G1 adapts the flood-fill implementation strategy from:

- Project: `viliusle/miniPaint`
- Reviewed commit: `a79733eb803fc97084ef0ee4faa96b031e69e1c0`
- Upstream file: `src/js/tools/fill.js`
- License: MIT

Only the portable pixel operation is adapted. miniPaint's App Shell, File/Open/Save, State/History authority, persistence, Layer identity and Project identity are not imported as NGVGE authority.
